name: megascenes-birthday-coloring
description: Create printable birthday coloring pages with clean black outlines on white: cakes, balloons, presents and party animals, with a name if you like.

interface.longDescription:
Name a birthday subject and how detailed it should be: a dinosaur with a party hat, a big cake with candles, balloons and presents, a parade of party animals, in simple bold shapes, medium detail or intricate patterns. Add a name to appear in outline letters. You get a coloring page with clean black outlines on white.

ChatGPT tells you what the page needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The page opens in the chat and stays in your library, ready to print.

For parents and hosts preparing the party table or a party favor, and for anyone who colors to relax.

Limitations: new pages from a description; it does not turn a photo into a coloring page. A name is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. Themes are original, not characters or brands owned by others. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Simple shapes or fine detail, with a name
Return the page in the chat
defaultPrompt: A birthday coloring page of a dinosaur with a party hat, simple shapes
A detailed birthday cake mandala coloring page for adults
A coloring page of balloons and presents with the name Mia

positive.prompt: A birthday coloring page of a dinosaur with a party hat, simple shapes. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one coloring page needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A detailed birthday cake mandala coloring page for adults. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one page needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a birthday coloring page here?
positive.expected_behavior: The coloring page models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A coloring page of balloons and presents with the name Mia in outline letters, medium detail. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my coloring page on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my coloring page to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
